newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica says no U.S. partner chosen yet.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica says no U.S. partner chosen yet.

text.p: The board of Spain's Telefonica met on Wednesday to discuss its international alliances, but has not yet decided on a U.S. partner, a spokesman for the firm said on Thursday.
"It's true that the board met yesterday to study the issue of an international partner, but it wasn't the only subject and we haven't made any decision yet," the spokesman told Reuters.
Local press reports today said the firm could be putting the final touches on a tie-up with MCI.
Telefonica chairman Juan Villalonga said in March that the firm would announce a U.S. partner within weeks, adding it was in talks with practically all operators.
Market analysts consider the most likely partners to be AT&T or MCI, giving Telefonica access to the hispanic market in the U.S..
